assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodic lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is indicated.
The denial under PR-204 conflicts with the documented need for prolonged rhythm monitoring.
